description: Lists the names of Tailwind's default colors for a Tailwind version (e.g. red, slate, mauve in v4), with the shades each one has and its 500 value as a sample. Use it to see which colors exist before calling get_tailwind_palette or picking a utility class.

tailwindVersion.description: The project's Tailwind CSS major version. Defaults to 4

name: list_tailwind_colors

sample.description: Tailwind's 500 value: oklch() in v4, hex in older versions

shades.description: Shades every color has, e.g. 50 to 950

title: List Tailwind's default colors
